from solution import Sort


def test_issue_example():
    """Sort sorts a list according to the second element in sublist."""
    assert Sort([['a', 10], ['b', 5], ['c', 20], ['d', 15]]) == [['b', 5], ['a', 10], ['d', 15], ['c', 20]]  # 5 < 10 < 15 < 20


def test_issue_empty():
    """Empty list sorted according to second element stays empty."""
    assert Sort([]) == []  # 0 == 0 entries


def test_issue_single():
    """Single sublist sorted according to second element is unchanged."""
    assert Sort([['x', 42]]) == [['x', 42]]  # 42 == 42 single key


def test_issue_reverse_sorted():
    """Sort orders reverse-ordered second elements ascending."""
    assert Sort([['a', 3], ['b', 2], ['c', 1]]) == [['c', 1], ['b', 2], ['a', 3]]  # 1 < 2 < 3


def test_issue_negative_zero_positive():
    """Sort handles negative, zero and positive second elements."""
    assert Sort([['a', 0], ['b', -5], ['c', 10], ['d', -1]]) == [['b', -5], ['d', -1], ['a', 0], ['c', 10]]  # -5 < -1 < 0 < 10


def test_issue_adjacent_integers():
    """Sort distinguishes values just above and below a threshold."""
    assert Sort([['a', 10], ['b', 9], ['c', 11]]) == [['b', 9], ['a', 10], ['c', 11]]  # 9 < 10 < 11


def test_issue_float_values():
    """Sort orders float second elements ascending."""
    assert Sort([['a', 2.5], ['b', 0.5], ['c', 1.5]]) == [['b', 0.5], ['c', 1.5], ['a', 2.5]]  # 0.5 < 1.5 < 2.5


def test_issue_ignores_first_element():
    """Sort uses second element, not first element, as the key."""
    assert Sort([['c', 1], ['a', 3], ['b', 2]]) == [['c', 1], ['b', 2], ['a', 3]]  # 1 < 2 < 3 so a,b,c order ignored


def test_issue_duplicate_second_elements():
    """Sort with duplicate second elements still orders keys ascending."""
    result = Sort([['a', 10], ['b', 5], ['c', 5]])
    assert [r[1] for r in result] == [5, 5, 10]  # 5 <= 5 <= 10


def test_contract_ascending_order():
    """Sorted output must be in ascending order of second element."""
    assert Sort([['x', 100], ['y', 1], ['z', 50]]) == [['y', 1], ['z', 50], ['x', 100]]  # 1 < 50 < 100


def test_contract_preserves_all_sublists():
    """Sorting must preserve every sublist while ordering by second element."""
    assert Sort([['a', 2], ['b', 1], ['c', 3]]) == [['b', 1], ['a', 2], ['c', 3]]  # 1 < 2 < 3 with 2 + 1 = 3 entries
